scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limits: Does not cover different density regulation, persistent sterile males, stage structure, stochastic eradication, continuous time, or multiple pulses. Abstract-only comparisons with Xue et al. (2012) and Berryman (1967) leave novelty risks.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.priority_integrity: Self-contained mathematical finding; novelty established only relative to sources materially inspected and searches; independent mathematical validation not performed.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proof_integrity: Full analytic proof is provided. Exact rational finite tests are corroboration rather than general certification.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: All R>0, s>0, x0>0, integer n>=2; first public source is foundational concept, not a claim of publication of the new theorem.

title: A sharp, dose-independent endpoint rule for a one-generation sterile-insect release
